description: Define or change (pass id) a custom field — admins only. Required: entity, label. Optional: key (derived from the label if omitted; cannot change later), type (default text), required, options (for select/multiselect), sort_order, active (false hides it without deleting values).

entity.description: Area the field belongs to: contacts, accounts, agreements, leads or a module table (mod_…)

id.description: ID of an existing custom field to change; omit to create a new one

key.description: Technical key; derived from the label if omitted, cannot be changed later

required.description: Whether a value must be filled in

sort_order.description: Position of the field in the display order

type.description: Field type: text, textarea, number, date, boolean, select or multiselect (default text)

name: upsert_custom_field
